title: MEDIAN retains subnormal midpoints on cancellation pairs and coerces direct args before held errors
statement: In Excel 16.0.20430 and 16.0.20527, MEDIAN validates and coerces direct scalar arguments before reading held errors inside ranges or arrays, skips held text, logicals, and blank cells, and computes an even-count midpoint as values[mid - 1] + half (flushing half = (values[mid] - values[mid - 1]) / 2 to 0 if below MIN_POSITIVE), while retaining subnormal final midpoints produced from normal inputs.
basis: Measured across 281 pinned MEDIAN rows in crates/calc-func/tests/witnesses/MEDIAN.json (including 161 fn10 subnormal-result cancellation pairs in Excel 16.0.20430) and jnt_w111_elementary in Excel 16.0.20527.20088, and matched across 43,412/43,412 full-bank and 281/281 pinned MEDIAN rows.

repros.recorded_in: Excel 16.0.20527.20088 Current Channel, Windows 64-bit (NT 10.0.26200), x86-64, AMD Ryzen 7 4800H, en-ZA

evidence.note: Direct-first coercion, even midpoint flushing, and subnormal output retention
